title: Lactonic sophorolipids by Saccharomyces cerevisiae: production, characterization and their evaluation for combating clinically important microbial pathogens
content:

The purpose of this study was to produce sophorolipids (SLs) through microbial conversion of Lepidium sativum (LS) oil cake, an agro-industrial waste, using locally isolated yeast (Saccharomyces cerevisiae).
